### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

### Clinical & Operational Context
Explain the clinical, administrative, or cybersecurity problem this feature addresses.

### Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature functioning.

### Impacted Clinical Roles
- [ ] Hospital Administrator
- [ ] Physician / Doctor
- [ ] Nurse
- [ ] Laboratory Technician
- [ ] Patient / Caregiver

### Privacy & Security Considerations
Detail any Row Level Security (RLS), Zero-PHI, or cryptographic impact this feature may have.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.
